parsed.summary: The PR adds a --skip-checks option to the runserver command, which is consistent with other management commands and helps speed up development by skipping system checks.

issues.description: The new test files and project structure introduced in the PR do not follow the existing conventions of the Django project, such as the absence of a newline at the end of files.
